snippet.title: Chase H.Q. (TG16) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A complete playthrough of Taito's 1992 TurboGrafx-16 arcade racer, Taito Chase H.Q.

Played through on the default settings. 

This is a port that really played to the Turbo's strengths. It's scales smoothly, controls well, and does everything at a surprisingly speedy clip. I personally much prefer this over the weird port/adaptation of the game on the Genesis.

I think that this also deserves the crown for being the toughest of the group. The SNES version is close, but man - this game can be brutal.
_______
No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
